mapper.select: SELECT * FROM answer_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.question_id, q.title AS question_title, r.user_answer, r.is_correct, r.score, r.time_cost_seconds, r.created_at FROM answer_record r LEFT JOIN question q ON q.id = r.question_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalAnswered, SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correctCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_correct = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wrongCount, AVG(score) AS avgScore FROM answer_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_correct IS NOT NULL

SELECT t.category AS category, COUNT(*) AS answeredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correctCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.is_correct = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wrongCount FROM answer_record ar INNER JOIN question_tag qt ON qt.question_id = ar.question_id INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = qt.tag_id WHERE ar.user_id = #{userId} AND ar.is_correct IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.category ORDER BY answeredCount DESC

SELECT t.id AS tagId, t.name AS tagName, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.is_correct = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wrongCount, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM answer_record ar INNER JOIN question_tag qt ON qt.question_id = ar.question_id INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = qt.tag_id WHERE ar.user_id = #{userId} AND ar.is_correct IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY wrongCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ar.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN ar.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1 ) AS correctRate FROM answer_record ar WHERE ar.user_id = #{userId} AND ar.is_correct IS NOT NULL AND ar.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ar.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
